notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hotfix Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented players from taking photos.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted map lighting to improve overall visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Monster updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Vision arc increased to [b]270°[/b] with a [b]50-unit[/b] detection range.[/p][/*][*][p]Base speed increased by [b]20%[/b] ([i]1.2×[/i]) from the start of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new mechanic: taking a photo of a monster will make it disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor fixes and optimizations.[/p][/*][/list][p]A special thanks goes to [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/missj3rik0"][/dynamiclink] and their entire community.
They helped us identify issues and significantly improve the game by providing constructive, actionable feedback.[/p]
